title: Passive Se: The Verb Agrees With the Thing
goal: Use passive se with a singular or plural noun and make the verb agree with it.
grammar: Passive se and agreement with the noun

items: I can make the verb agree with the noun after passive se.
I can use se with poder or deber and an infinitive.
I can use the new words for agreements, rules and announcements.
